scope: Add a bilingual syntactic parsing chapter after morphology and before RNN. No new practice route.

sources.sections: Jurafsky & Martin, Speech and Language Processing ch. 19 §§19.5–19.8, ch. 20 §§20.1–20.4
sources.verification: PP attachment ambiguity, fencepost intervals, packed CKY entries, evaluation of spans, dependency attachment, stack transitions and globally constrained arcs. The telescope chart is an independent worked example.

sources.sections: Alzetta et al., Parallel Trees §2.1 and Fig. 1; UD v2 CoNLL-U format and obl, nmod, case
sources.verification: Read the two trees from the same source sentence; preserved the cantata → stile → in path. Verify the head, label and direction for the English example separately.

sources.sections: Stern, Andreas & Klein, A Minimal Span-Based Neural Constituency Parser §§2–4 and Fig. 1
sources.verification: Check shared span representation, separate scores, label ∅ and split points 1 and 4. Contrast with the grammar-based CKY example without calling the illustration a CKY trace.

sources.sections: Chen & Manning, A Fast and Accurate Dependency Parser using Neural Networks §§2–3
sources.verification: Match stack top, head direction, dependent removal and initial/terminal root. The two independent traces use UD v2 labels, not the older tag set in the article.

figures.modifications: Crop of both complete panels and labels from the original PDF. No redraw.
